svg.title: Same amount, different fraction
svg.desc: Equal invented 1 mL plasma aliquots each contain four tumor-attributed molecule symbols. A has 16 background symbols and 20 total; B has 36 background symbols and 40 total. Four molecules per mL stays equal while the recovered-molecule share drops from 4/20, or 20%, to 4/40, or 10%. These toy molecule shares are not automatically variant allele fraction, an assay-estimated tumor fraction or MTM/mL; those quantities require their stated method and model.
svg.metadata: Original hand-authored editable SVG by agent:/root/batch09_author_group2. No image-generation invocation. Invented teaching example; human review pending. No patient result or clinical threshold.
svg.text: Invented molecules • equal 1 mL plasma volumes
